rv.q: It's a brilliant show that appeals to all ages... I don't think any other musical stars as magically as this one.

Nearly thirty years after its Broadway debut, The Lion King remains an astonishing example of what happens when commercial entertainment and uncompromising artistic imagination are allowed to coexist.
Julie Taymor’s costumes are by far the show stealer.

ta: Queensland Performing Arts Centre, Cultural Centre, South Bank QLD 4101
